description: A typed, attributed assertion the agent wants the system to act on. A claim with no measurement has no path to a payment.

asserted_by.description: Who or what asserts this claim (agent, gate, rail, verifier).

asserted_value.description: The asserted facts, in the units the gate will measure.

measurement.description: The independent re-measurement. Absent means unmeasured, and unmeasured refuses.

subject.description: What the claim is about, in checkable terms.

reason.description: The named refusal reason. Required in spirit on refuse; gates always name it.

title: Claim
